items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Leanna's married since I last saw her. Who? [INTERVIEWEE] Lynette.

ctx.x: That's where we were originally married in the small Corpus Christi Church, where it was just a small church and has grown to be one of the largest churches in the world, which is predominantly neighborhood.
And Leanna's married since I last saw her. Who?
